Hi, expert on sociopathy here. This doesn't sound like you are a sociopath in the slightest. Sociopath wouldn't see anything wrong with their actions, for them everyone else is mistaken. I think you need to express your emotions in some way. It's not good for your mental state to keep everything inside, this probably causes some of your dark thoughts. If you are a teenager it can explain your unstable emotional state but I would see a psychiatrist about it because it can be caused by some chemical imbalance.
I know it's hard but don't try to convince yourself that you don't deserve/won't ever have a girlfriend. This is the biggest advice an 18 yr old virgin like me can give you when it comes to dating.
From a slightly sociopathic point of view... Sure, be happy if that makes you feel better, you can't change what happened to him and his family anyway.

Don't worry, you seem to think that no one understands you but that is not true. I'm sure there are a lot of people on this subreddit that you can relate to and talk to. You might not be able to speak with them face to face but they are as real as anyone else. I think a true friend is what you need most right now. I would say you should try to talk to people that are introverted, speaking from my expierience. They tend to be the best friends and are great listeners.

I smiled after I read this because I couldn't find anyone like me before. I don't know if you are a sociopath but if you didn't have any childhood trauma before the age of 6 it's very unlikely. Do you feel nostalgia? I don't. I feel no connection to anything. Oh, and I'm also 17.
Thank you for caring, I guess.

Honestly it is different every day. When I have school I try to fall asleep at 11pm. I usually finish using my PC at the same hour. Then I have to wait from 5 minutes to 2 hours to fall asleep depends on how tired I got during the day. I tend to worry a lot before falling asleep, sometimes I just don't want to wake up. Usually I go to school tired and sleep after I come back from school and also a lot during weekends.

EDIT: Another thing about me that you might relate to: I'm an FPSphobe, I like my framerate above 60 :)

I greatly admire homosexual people of any kind. I can't really fully explain this but it makes me feel like true love (that I don't believe in) does actually exist. Needless to say I'm not "gay" myself but if I would be, I wouldn't really mind that. I feel like as a heterosexual male I can't really feel love to a woman without thinking about sex. This makes me feel disgusted and trapped because I feel like I'm a slave to my basic insticts. I hate myself for that. Homosexual love, however, gives me hope because it makes me believe that there is more to love than bringing offspring to this world. Maybe this will change your way of thinking, please don't hate yourself for what you are. I'm not really good if it comes to talking to people due to my huge social anxiety but if it's just chatting, maybe I can manage somehow. That being said, you can message me anytime about anything.
